extracted text: The title compound was synthesised hydrothermally in a Teflon-lined stainless steel autoclave at 170°C for 14 days from a mixture containing 1.453g of GeO2 (amorphous, Aldrich), 0.464mL (0.417g) of ethylenediamine (en) (Aldrich) and 10mL of water, which gives the following molar composition: GeO2:0.5 en:40 H2O. Both initial and final pH values of the mixture were about 11. The final product was recovered by filtration, washed several times with deionised water and then dried at 70°C for 24h.
